user.title: Connect to XGIMI Projector Wake & Control
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your XGIMI projector (ensure Wireless ADB on port 5555 is enabled in Developer Options).

authorize.title: Authorize ADB Connection
authorize.description: Check your projector screen ({host}) for the **Allow USB debugging?** prompt, check **Always allow from this computer**, select **OK**, and then click **Submit**.

error.invalid_host: Invalid hostname or IP address (do not include http:// or paths).
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach projector ADB on port 5555. Verify the IP address and ensure ADB debugging is enabled.
error.adb_not_authorized: ADB authorization was not approved on the projector yet. Please select 'Always allow from this computer' -> OK on the projector and try again.

abort.already_configured: This XGIMI projector is already configured.

init.description: Update the projector network host or Wake-on-LAN MAC address.
